title: When each state legislature is elected
usableAnswer: A table of the fifty states, with the chamber election years and, for staggered senates, the rule that decides which districts are up (by district number, or by a lot drawn after redistricting); the general election day; the filing deadline and primary date as days before the general election (a national default with the named exceptions); and a realistic range for the number of general-election candidates per legislative race, including the uncontested share. Approximate primary and filing figures are fine; the election years and the staggering rule must be exact.
whyItMatters: A legislative race was decided about a month after filing, so a candidate filed in August and was elected in September. The calendar is now the right shape but is a profile, not each state's law, and every race has exactly one rival.

answer.summary: The attached 56-place table supplies sourced 2026 congressional primary and filing dates with district/office exceptions, not legislative deadlines. 2028 primaries are not extrapolated. The source identifies Alabama split district dates and distinct Louisiana House/Senate and Virginia filing dates; a single primary-lead default would lose these facts.
